tools.name: generate_site_llms_txt
tools.description: Crawls any documentation or SaaS site and compiles a standards-compliant /llms.txt manifest and JSON-LD schema bundle. WHEN TO USE: Call `generate_site_llms_txt` when your task requires deterministic `llms-generator` analysis for `url`; use `get_agent_wallet_status` to check your remaining free tria

tools.name: get_agent_wallet_status
tools.description: Inspect an agent's account ledger: remaining free trial calls (out of 5), prepaid USD balance, cumulative spend, total API calls, and total LLM tokens saved. WHEN TO USE: Call before a batch of paid tool executions or after completing a Stripe or USDC top-up to confirm your balance. WHEN NOT TO USE:

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_site_llms_txt · Private data: get_agent_wallet_status · Public sink: get_agent_wallet_status · Destructive: get_agent_wallet_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_site_llms_txt · Private data: get_agent_wallet_status · Public sink: get_agent_wallet_status · Destructive: get_agent_wallet_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
